name: ai-coach
description: AI Coach — harness your team. A coach for using Claude Code well, one focus per release.

plugins.name: ai-coach-core
plugins.description: The engine every AI Coach plugin runs on: session memory, hooks, secrets guard, and the coached session brief.

plugins.name: memory-coach
plugins.description: Memory you can search, conclusions you can hand to a teammate, and trust you keep private: /recall, /debrief, /handoff, /team, /project, /doctor.

plugins.name: prompt-coach
plugins.description: Write prompts that land, see which habits actually cost you time, and brief a context that cannot ask you a follow-up: /prompt, /prompt-stats, /dispatch.

plugins.name: security-coach
plugins.description: Injection defense on every fetch, OWASP-grounded audits, and pentest triage: /scan, /audit, /triage.

plugins.name: harness-coach
plugins.description: The toolbox next to the coach: detect, pick, and install the partner tools that pair well with Claude Code — /partners.

plugins.name: investigation-coach
plugins.description: Onboard anyone onto the project: generated docs, an architecture map you can open in Obsidian or edit in draw.io, and study material — /onboard, /map, /study.

plugins.name: atlas-coach
plugins.description: Everything outside the repo: verified web research, documents-in-markdown-out ingestion, and claim-checked analysis — /research, /ingest, /analyze.

plugins.name: strategy-coach
plugins.description: Document what the business is and specify what comes next: an Obsidian vault of actors, processes and rules mapped to code, feature specs with a checkable definition of done, the competitive gap, the industry rules you must live inside, and how that industry already solved a gap — /vault, /blueprint, /feature, /market.

plugins.name: ai-coach
plugins.description: Install this one. Pulls in the engine and every coach released so far.
